ns2:section.sectionText: The ADV 150 and 281 pre-requisites will not be enforced in Spring 2023. Priority for registration is given to ADV, CS+ADV, and Ag COMM majors who started their collegiate coursework prior to or in Fall 2021. If seats are available, they will be released to majors who began coursework in Fall 2022 on November 18 by 12pm. *Students must register for the Lecture and one Discussion/Lab section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Advertising or Agricultural Communications or Computer Science & Advertising or Ag Communications-Advertising major(s) or minor(s).
